subject: POC activation checkpoints & streaming route map
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@fintegrate.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & proposed POC activation checkpoints

Hi Daniel / Sara —

Great demo earlier — thanks for the thoughtful questions. As promised, here's a concise recap and a concrete activation plan so we can get the POC running next week. I tried to keep the checkpoints measurable and ownership clear so Fintegrate can evaluate impact early.

Top-level objective:
- Run a 4-week POC to validate Redwood inference for transaction categorization at scale while meeting latency and cost targets.

Success criteria (pass/fail gates):
- Accuracy: model labels match Fintegrate gold set >= 88% macro-F1 on the sample dataset (we'll provide evaluation harness).
- Latency: 95th percentile per-request latency < 180ms for 256-token average payload under synthetic 10 RPS load.
- Throughput: steady-state streaming throughput of 40 requests/sec with continuous batching enabled.
- Cost: inference token cost target <= 0.009 USD/token (approx) with caching/batching profile enabled.
- Observability: end-to-end tracing and per-route token cost shown in Redwood Console within 48 hours of activation.

Evaluation plan and timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff + invite to shared Drive + exchange of sample dataset (Fintegrate) and access details.
- Week 1: infra and SDK integration. Engineer onboarding + run first smoke tests (unit test set).
- Week 2: synthetic load testing and latency tuning (batching, kv-cache warmup).
- Week 3: quality runs against gold set + monitoring checks.
- Week 4: acceptance window and decision call (go/no-go).

Integration/implementation checklist (SDK & routes):
- SDK: use redwood-js v1.4.0 (we recommend pinning) — sample snippets attached in auth-scope-readme.md.
- API routes: POST /v1/generate for single-turn inference; POST /v1/stream for streaming evaluation (chunked token frames).
- Streaming: set stream=true and use EventSource consumer; we suggest 128-token streaming chunks for UI use cases to optimize latency.
- Tool calling: if Fintegrate wants tool-extraction for entity normalization, define function schemas in the attached success-criteria sheet; Redwood will map function_name -> tool endpoint and return structured JSON.

Ownership:
- Fintegrate: Daniel (technical lead) for dataset and test scenarios; Sara (product) for acceptance.
- Redwood: Hannah (engagement lead) for PM coordination; Marissa (integration engineer) for SDK and streaming setup; Ben (sales engineering) for demo + fallback model configs.

Next actions (from today):
1) Daniel to share the sample gold dataset + API whitelist for IPs by EOD Thursday.
2) Redwood (Marissa) to provide an SDK quickstart repo + a minimal streaming example by Friday.
3) Schedule a 60-minute tech-handoff call Monday 2028-08-28 (Marissa + Daniel + Hannah).

Attachments: poc-success-criteria.xlsx (detailed gates), sdk-route-map.png (endpoint map), auth-scope-readme.md (how to provision test API keys).

Thanks — excited to get started.

—
Hannah Schmitt

Hi all —

I can do 9:00am PT Monday for the tech-handoff. Quick prep notes from the integration side so Daniel has visibility:

- SDK quickstart: I'll push a minimal repo that authenticates using API key (scoped: "poc:read,poc:stream") and shows both a /v1/generate call and an EventSource /v1/stream consumer. Expect the repo link in the Drive by Friday evening.
- Streaming config: set connection_keepalive=30s and chunk_size=128; for load tests we recommend using continuous_batching=true with max_batch_tokens=2048.
- KV cache warmup: we'll submit a small batch of frequent prefixes to warm the cache; this typically reduces cold-start token usage by ~25%.
- Fallbacks: we'll configure a cheaper quantized variant for non-critical routes to keep cost within target; Ben and I will set the route policy in the Console.

Testing plan items I want from Fintegrate before Monday:
1) Confirm the sample dataset format (CSV columns + id field).
2) Provide public IP ranges or the IP allowlist (for test keys).
3) Identify one UI flow that needs streaming vs. one that can use single-turn.

I'll include a short checklist in the SDK repo README so the first smoke run is scriptable.

—
